one_month_reasoning: No scheduled Keysight event before 2026-12-20: Q1 FY27 results are due around late February 2027. In the window: CFO handover to Jason Kary in December (CEO Satish Dhanasekaran, Q4 FY26 remarks) and post-earnings drift after a beat-and-raise (Q1 guide $2.05B vs $1.96B consensus, src 26) set against a tech selloff that has left the stock ~33% below its October high. We give a small +1% drift for the guide-driven estimate revisions and otherwise a lognormal at the stock's usual monthly volatility (48% / 3.5 = 13.7%) centered near $261.51.

fair_value.method: Engine base on our quarterly driver build: P/E 18.5x on NTM non-GAAP EPS at the horizon (~$18.6, FY28) = $343 (0.45), levered LTM FCF yield 3.84% = $395 (0.30), normalized mid-cycle earnings $15.04 x 21.45x = $322.5 (0.25); research target (12m) $353.48.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS at 2027-11-20 from the build (FY28 $18.60, FY27 $16.12) x 18.5x (peer median 21.45x shrunk k=0.8 from own 17.86x); consensus FY27 EPS from a current dated page not available, pre-print FY27 revenue consensus $8.15B vs our $9.03B

inputs_detail.derivation: LightCounting (published 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-02): Ethernet optical transceiver sales +~90% 2025, +120% 2026, +76% 2027, slowing to ~20% by 2031 ('soft landing'). 2028 62% and 2029 48% are straight-line steps between LightCounting's 2027 (76%) and 2031 (20%) points: (76-20)/4 = 14 points a year. Fiscal quarter = calendar quarter one back (FQ1 Nov-Jan ~ CQ4). Alternatives: LightCounting 'bumpy ride' (flat/negative years 2027-2030) sized at -1.5% on the research target (12m) with 2028 0% and 2029 -10%; hyperscaler 2027 capex consensus from a current dated page not found (searched 2026-11-23: Moody's/DCD undated, Morgan Stanley 2026-08-08 and Goldman 2026-06-11 both older than the 90-day window, Vanguard chart undated), so the capex series is used only qualitatively (src 25).
inputs_detail.variant_view: If 2027 cloud capex grows ~22% (the June consensus Goldman cited) rather than LightCounting's assumed 50%, optics growth in 2027 could be nearer 40%: with cc_e 0.27 that cuts FY28 revenue ~3% and the target ~2%.

inputs_detail.derivation: Seasonally adjusted q/q commercial communications growth / quarterly optics growth ((1+optics_g)^0.25-1). FY26 Q2-Q4 realized 0.424 (858/758=1.132 /1.0362 seasonal = +9.24% vs 21.8%), 0.706 (1006/858 /1.0161), 0.646 (1145/1006 /0.9976): mean 0.59. Annual fits: FY24 ~0.05 (CC trend +1.0%/q vs optics +18.9%/q), FY25 ~0.16 (+2.8%/q vs +17.4%/q), FY26 0.59; three-year mean 0.27. Q1 FY27 (the next quarter) at the FY26 fit because record backlog, Q4 orders +53% and the Q1 guide all point to the current regime; later quarters at the through-cycle mean (rule 0c, LightCounting cycle warning). Evidence-based alternatives sized with the engine: 0.59 for all FY27 quarters +5.8%; 0.59 for all years +9.5%; 0.27 including Q1 -2.9%.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Management's 20% FY27 base case implies a weaker capture (FY27 revenue $8.59B vs our $9.03B); the FY26 fit kept throughout gives FY27 ~$9.4B.

downside.story: Optics 'bumpy ride' (LightCounting's alternative scenario): the transceiver supply chain overbuilt in 2026-27, Ethernet optics growth falls to ~-4% in 2027 and -18% in 2028 (driver -80 points), CC capture drops 30%, fab equipment growth 20 points lower, ADG 5 points lower; FY27 revenue ~$8.1B, FY28-29 flat to down; margins 4 points lower (~30.5%, FY23 level); P/E 13.5x and FCF yield ~5.2% (trough multiples), normalized leg -40%.

base.story: LightCounting soft landing (optics +76% 2027, slowing), Q1 FY27 at the FY26 capture then the through-cycle mean: FY27 revenue $9.03B (+26%, 5% above the company's 20% base case), FY28 $10.1B, FY29 $11.1B; non-GAAP EPS $16.12 / $18.60 / $20.80; operating margin ~35%; valued at 18.5x P/E, 3.84% FCF yield and a 28.6% mid-cycle margin cross-check.

upside.story: Soft landing plus: 1.6T/3.2T and co-packaged optics ramps keep capture nearer the FY26 fit (+0.15), optics growth 15 points above LightCounting, 6G funded development and fab starts add; FY28 revenue ~$11.7B, margins up with incrementals +5 points; P/E 21x (near peer median) and FCF yield 3.45%.

sbc_treatment.note: FY26 SBC $226M (cash flow statement; $227M non-GAAP add-back); FY25 $162M (F29). Adjusted EBIT and non-GAAP EPS exclude SBC, so SBC is counted once through share dilution: shares change -1.0% a year net of ~$700M buybacks, which pay for the SBC issuance in cash (buybacks reduce cash in the bridge). Peers' NTM consensus (Zacks) is on the same adjusted basis.

reasoning: Industry lane first. The chain is still accelerating into Keysight's FY27: Lumentum Q1 FY27 revenue +136% with a Q2 guide of ~$1.6B (src 31), Viavi NSE +74% and a $505-515M Q2 guide (src 23), Teradyne Q3 +70% (src 24), Advantest raised its FY2026 sales forecast to JPY 1,863B (src 32), LightCounting sees Ethernet optics +120% in 2026 and +76% in 2027 (srcs 17, 18), SEMI sees 300mm fab equipment +31% in 2026 and double digits to 2029 (src 19), Allianz Trade sees European defense spending growth slowing to 9% from above 20% in 2024/2025 (src 20, published 2026-10-20), and hyperscaler executives say 2027 capex rises 'significantly' (src 25). Keysight itself printed Q4 FY26 orders $2,339M (+53%) vs revenue $1,994M, FY26 orders $8.1B vs revenue $7.2B, and guided Q1 FY27 to $2.04-2.06B vs $1.96B consensus with a 20% FY27 base case (srcs 1, 3). Build: three economic drivers (optics market, 300mm fab equipment, allied defense) mapped through capture terms fitted on FY23-FY26 end-market history, with FY23-FY25 seasonal factors, plus an incremental-margin driver. Q1 FY27 uses the FY26 capture (0.59), later quarters the through-cycle mean (0.27) to stay moderately conservative (rule 0c): FY27 revenue $9.03B (+26%), 5% above the company's base case and 4% below its record-adjusted level (beat 2 of 2 annual base cases, 8 of 8 quarterly guides by a median 2.8%). Margins ~35% (Q4 FY26 already 35.8%); the 110 bp tariff refund is removed from the base. Valuation: P/E 18.5x and FCF yield 3.84% from four whole-company peers with the k=0.8 shrink, plus a 25% normalized leg at a 28.6% mid-cycle margin because the build's margins sit above the last cycle's average. Base $353, +35% vs $261.51: the market is pricing peak earnings (~16x FY27 EPS). Downside P10 is LightCounting's 'bumpy ride' with trough multiples; upside P90 keeps FY26-like capture. Research limits: no current dated FY27 EPS consensus (StockAnalysis still dated 2026-10-09, Nasdaq page empty, Twelve Data estimates locked, Nasdaq API blocked) and no current dated 2027 hyperscaler capex consensus (Moody's undated, Morgan Stanley 2026-08-08 and Goldman 2026-06-11 past the window), so neither enters a number; Anritsu's October results page was not reachable. Source mix: 20 of 32 sources are Keysight's own releases, remarks and filings used for basic reported facts and the guidance record (allowed whatever the lane); of the other 12, 11 are in lane (competitors, suppliers, customers, industry trackers, peer data) and one is a consensus page. Not driver-linked: the normalized-earnings custom leg.

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver-led set (16 quarters: FY26 actual base, FY27-FY29 forecast). Revenue: commercial communications = prior quarter x (1 + cc_e x quarterly optics growth) x seasonal factor; ADG = same quarter last year x (1 + adg_g); EISG = prior quarter x (1 + 0.30 x quarterly 300mm fab equipment growth) x seasonal factor. Segment EBIT = prior quarter EBIT + inc_m x revenue change (Q1 FY27 base net of the 110 bp tariff refund). Driven share 100% of revenue (ADG via its own growth driver). Value carried by the P/E leg (0.45) and levered LTM FCF yield leg (0.30, 40% of P/E+FCF per the tech rule) on the build, plus a normalized mid-cycle earnings leg (0.25, playbook cross-check). No DCF leg (not a neocloud). Adjusted EBIT (segment basis = company non-GAAP operating income, excludes amortization and SBC), SBC counted through share dilution net of buybacks.
model_inputs.gap_note: For Kilian (judgment calls sized with the engine, >5%): cc_e at the FY26 fit 0.59 for all FY27 quarters +5.8% (all years +9.5%) vs our Q1-only 0.59 then the 0.27 through-cycle mean; inc_m at the FY26 53% throughout +5.4%; exit multiple at the peer median exactly (21.45x, 3.5%) +10.2% vs the k=0.8 shrink. Normalized leg weight 0.25 is judgment (playbook range 0.2-0.4), untested. Peer count 4 whole-company peers (flagged). Interest income path rests on our cash roll at the FY26 yield. Financing: none probable (net cash $407M, $833M buyback authorization); refinancing the $700M current debt at a similar coupon is assumed, probability of an equity or convertible raise < 5%. fair_value.value = engine base.
